description: This file defines the MatriculaService class, which provides service methods related to 'Matricula' (enrollment) management, including creating new matricula entries linked to courses and users.

classes.name: MatriculaService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing enrollment ('matricula') operations, including creation of matricula records associating users with courses.

methods.name: createMatricula
methods.description: Creates a new enrollment record for the specified course and user, throwing an exception if the user is already enrolled.
